
### Use it

- **In your browser:** [KERNEL](https://dogum.github.io/kernel/kernel.html) · [KERNEL·A, with the agent](https://dogum.github.io/kernel/kernel-agent.html) · [KERNEL·M, for phones](https://dogum.github.io/kernel/kernel-agent-mobile.html)
- **Offline or self-hosted:** download the `.html` files below. Each is the whole app; open it in a browser or put it on any static host.
- **The Claude skill:** upload `kernel-notebooks.skill` in Claude.ai under Settings → Capabilities → Skills.
